slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: The agent can propose a stack. You still own it.
slides.subtitle: Technology choice is architecture work, even with coding agents.

slides.title: Ask for options
slides.body: After scoping the product, ask the agent for multiple stack choices and trade-offs. Do not let it silently decide.

slides.title: Choose what you can maintain
slides.body: I chose Django because I know it well. I can read, review, debug, and operate the generated code faster.

slides.title: Challenge the proposal
slides.body: Ask whether a dependency is needed, whether the version is current, whether the MVP can be simpler, and what can be deferred.

slides.title: Own the consequences
slides.body: Hosting model, background jobs, APIs, dependencies, and operational complexity remain your responsibility.
